JoSAA Round 5 Schedule 2026: Your Gateway to Top Engineering Institutes!

The Joint Seat Allocation Authority (JoSAA) 2026 counselling process is in full swing, and Round 5 is here, marking a critical juncture for thousands of engineering aspirants vying for a coveted spot in IITs, NITs, IIITs, and GFTIs. As the counselling draws to a close, understanding the precise schedule and key deadlines for Round 5 is paramount to secure your admission. If you've been eagerly awaiting your dream institute, this round could be your final opportunity to lock in a seat.

"Round 5 is the final phase for IITs and IISc Bengaluru admissions through JoSAA. Make sure all your reporting and fee payments are completed on time to avoid missing out!"

JoSAA Round 5: Key Dates to Remember

The Joint Seat Allocation Authority (JoSAA) has meticulously planned the 2026 counselling schedule to ensure a smooth and transparent process. Round 5, in particular, carries significant weight, especially for those targeting admissions to the Indian Institutes of Technology (IITs) and the Indian Institute of Science (IISc) Bengaluru. Here’s a detailed breakdown of the important dates:

Event Date (2026)
Seat Allocation (Round 5) July 16
Online Reporting: Fee Payment / Document Upload / Response by Candidate to Queries (Round 5) July 16 to July 20
Last Date for Fee Payment (Round 5) July 20
Resolution of Fee Payment Issues (Round 5) July 21

It is crucial for all candidates to strictly adhere to these deadlines. Missing any of the stipulated dates can lead to the forfeiture of your allotted seat. The official JoSAA website, josaa.nic.in, remains the primary source for all updates and result announcements.

Understanding the Finality of Round 5

For candidates aspiring to join IITs and IISc Bengaluru, JoSAA Round 5 is the ultimate opportunity. No further JoSAA allotment rounds will be conducted for these premier institutions after Round 5. This means that if you are allotted a seat in an IIT or IISc Bengaluru in Round 5, this is your final chance to accept it. The withdrawal facility for IIT and IISc seats closed on July 14, 2026, meaning no withdrawal is possible once Round 5 allotment begins.

However, for admissions to NITs, IIITs, and GFTIs (collectively known as the NIT+ system), while Round 5 is significant, the process doesn't entirely conclude here. Any seats remaining vacant after JoSAA Round 5 for these institutions will be carried forward to the Central Seat Allocation Board (CSAB) Special Rounds. NIT+ system candidates also have a slightly extended window for withdrawal during Round 5, from July 16 to July 20, 2026.

What to Do After Seat Allotment in Round 5

Once the JoSAA Round 5 seat allotment results are announced on July 16, 2026, candidates must immediately log in to the official portal (josaa.nic.in) to check their status.

1. Review Your Allotment
Carefully check the institute and course allotted to you. Consider if it aligns with your preferences and career goals.
2. Choose Your Option (Freeze, Float, Slide)
  • Freeze: If you are satisfied with the allotted seat and do not wish to participate in further rounds, choose 'Freeze'.
  • Float: If you accept the current seat but wish to be considered for a higher preference in subsequent rounds (only applicable for NIT+ system candidates, as Round 5 is final for IITs/IISc).
  • Slide: If you accept the current seat but wish to be considered for a better preference within the same institute (only applicable for NIT+ system candidates).

For IITs and IISc, Round 5 is the last opportunity, so freezing your seat would be the logical step if satisfied, or you might consider alternatives outside JoSAA if not.

3. Complete Online Reporting
This involves paying the seat acceptance fee, uploading the necessary documents, and responding to any queries raised by the verifying officers. Ensure all documents are accurate and uploaded within the stipulated timeframe of July 16 to July 20, 2026.
4. Pay Partial Admission Fee (PAF)
For candidates allocated seats in NIT+, IIITs, or GFTIs, after Round 5, it is mandatory to pay the Partial Admission Fee (PAF) to confirm acceptance of the allotted seat and to be eligible for CSAB Special Rounds (if applicable). Failure to pay the PAF will result in the cancellation of your seat.

Important Considerations for Round 5

✅ No New Choices: Remember, you were allowed to fill and lock your choices only once, by June 11, 2026. No new choices can be added or rearranged in subsequent rounds.

✅ Document Verification: Keep all your original documents ready for online verification. Any discrepancies can lead to the cancellation of your seat.

✅ Stay Updated: Regularly check the official JoSAA website (josaa.nic.in) for any last-minute announcements or changes.

✅ CSAB Special Rounds: If you are aiming for NITs, IIITs, or GFTIs and don't secure a seat in JoSAA Round 5, keep an eye on the CSAB 2026 website for details on special rounds.

JoSAA Round 5 is a decisive stage in the counselling process. By being well-informed about the schedule and diligently following the steps, you can successfully navigate this final hurdle and secure your admission to a top engineering institute. Good luck!
